summary: Banzai International filed an 8-K/A amending its September 11, 2026 disclosure of a September 4, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor for a private placement of a convertible promissory note initially $2,142,857.14 (up to $3,571,428.57) plus warrants for up to 779,221 Class A shares and 519,480 additional tranche warrants, placed via Aegis Capital Corp. as exclusive placement agent under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506. Revisions set the cross-default threshold at $250,000, grant the purchaser a 25% future-financing participation right through September 18, 2027, and split Tranche 2 into $190,000 and $310,000 fundings. Watch dilution and overhang.
